tables.samples_colombia.parquet: Colombian training/validation sample points with every predictor (2000, 2015/2018, 1992/1999), Fagan label, authors' map values
tables.prediction_grid_features.parquet: 1-in-100 systematic grid over the study domain with every predictor and label
tables.prediction_grid_step2.parquet: Step-2 model predictions on the grid (uncalibrated, prior-shift, isotonic) and the authors' map
tables.mapbiomas_labels_grid.parquet: MapBiomas Colombia C3 regrowth labels (all windows), 2012 predictors and land-use history at the grid points
